card.name: Spaces and brackets in chemotherapy regimens
card.fires_on: Punctuation or a space right before a number or abbreviation in cancer chemotherapy text, such as the space before a dose number or an opening parenthesis after a drug list. It appears in leukemia, lymphoma and Wilms tumor regimens.

modes.description: A blank space just before an age or dose figure in a dosing sentence.
